facts.text: The Guaranteed Tuition Program provides eligible undergraduate students with a constant tuition rate and mandatory fees for eight continuous semesters.

sources.title: Guaranteed Tuition Program FAQs | Bursar
sources.quote: The Guaranteed Tuition Program is the University of Arizona's commitment to provide students, who initially enroll prior or beginning with the Fall 2024/Spring 2025 semester with a constant tuition rate and mandatory fees, as set by the Arizona Board of Regents for eight (8) continuous semesters
